title: Pre-clean comparison plan
body: Compare the standard solvent clean with the plasma clean on the same batch of four substrates. Record particle counts before and after each clean.

title: Sensor cable repaired
body: The loose sensor cable was re-seated. The repeat run gave a thickness reading within the expected range, so the earlier outlier looks like a cable fault and not a process problem.

title: Holder swap trial
body: A new substrate holder was tried. Thickness variation between runs dropped, which supports the idea that the old holder was the main source of spread.

title: Fume cabinet check
body: Checked the fume extraction flow before the next run. Flow was normal. The isopropyl wipes have been moved to the cabinet on the left wall.
